summary: Google DeepMind released Optax v0.2.7, a JAX gradient-processing and optimization library, with new optimizers, transformations, deprecations and bug fixes accumulated across many pull requests.

practices.reason: Teams using Optax's global_norm or second-order utilities need to migrate to the new APIs before the deprecated functions are removed.
practices.quote: Deprecate optax.global_norm in favor of optax.tree.norm. by @carlosgmartin in https://github.com/google-deepmind/optax/pull/1368
